channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Why is the UK mired in a maternity and neonatal deaths scandal?
item.description: An inquiry found that more than 500 mothers and babies either came to harm or died due to poor care.

item.title: Gaza sports community pledges to continue legacy of killed goalkeeper
item.description: Slain seeking cooking gas, Gaza goalkeeper Saleem al-Ashqar joins more than 1,000 Palestinian athletes killed in war.

item.title: Russia’s advance collapses in Ukraine, ‘40,000’ troops killed in June
item.description: Ukraine's long-range strikes hit targets in Russia, where anxiety is rising.

item.title: Mourners pay respects as Iran’s slain leader Ali Khamenei lies in state
item.description: Iran begins seven-day state funeral for late ayatollah as some 100 foreign delegations arrive under a tense ceasefire

item.title: Russia’s triumphant tone shifts as Ukraine deploys ‘asymmetrical tactics’
item.description: Putin wobbles as Russia's top brass stays mum on Kyiv's long-range strikes, which analysts say look set to continue.

item.title: France records 2,025 excess deaths at peak of heatwave as Europe braces for more extreme weather
item.description: Forecasters are warning of further extreme temperatures on the continent in the next few days.

item.title: Iran begins public mourning for Ayatollah killed in February
item.description: Ali Khamenei's body will lie in state in Tehran's Grand Mosalla from Friday ahead of days-long funeral events.

item.title: On the Strait of Hormuz, BBC finds seized ships and shark fishermen as uneasy calm returns
item.description: The BBC travels to the city of Bandar Abbas - the first international journalists to visit the Iranian side of the strait.

item.title: Ebola treatments trial begins in DR Congo
item.description: According to WHO data, there have been 1,406 confirmed cases of the disease in DRC, with 301 suspected cases and 438 deaths.

item.title: Canadian boy, 11, dies of rabies after waking to bat on his face
item.description: Rabies infections are rare in Canada. There have been 28 human deaths due to rabies in the country since 1924.
